name: Inventory
description: Inventory adds one table to the dashboard that lists every item in your libraries with the attributes that matter for storage and quality: size, size per hour of runtime, bitrate, codecs, resolution, HDR and Dolby Vision format, audio layout and languages. Pick the columns you want per media type.
overview: A sortable, filterable table of everything in your libraries.

versions.changelog:
### Added

- Rows per page, chosen in the footer and kept across restarts, from 50 up to 10000.
- Three columns totalling playback over every account on the server: how often something was played, when it last was, and how many accounts have played it to the end, which on a folder counts only the accounts that have played everything below it.
- The tab whose rows are on their way and the export being built now show that they are working.
- `Schema` reports the culture it answered in, which is what the page takes its plural form from.

### Changed

- What was labelled Played is now Fully played, since Jellyfin only ticks it when something ran to the end.
- The export is written to a temporary file rather than built in memory, and stops when the browser goes away.
- `Items` and `Export` refuse a sort column they do not know instead of quietly sorting by the first one.
- Every change is tested against each Jellyfin release from 12.0 on, one run per major and minor version, taken from the published image tags.

### Fixed

- A film split across several files reported the size of the first file alone, and no runtime at all.
- A trailer or a making of sitting beside a film was listed as an item of its own, in a tab of its own, and its bytes counted towards the totals.
- The frame rate could read 1000 fps where Jellyfin's own interface shows the real one.
- An item Jellyfin marks played on reaching the end of playback did not reach the table until the next stop report.
- The two dropdowns had no arrow, the search field put an empty label into the toolbar, and a disabled button looked exactly like one that could be clicked.
- A first load that failed left the page blank, with an empty column picker behind the Columns button.
- Expanding a level asked for every fifty rows at once, so a large page could open hundreds of requests at a time.
- A row that turned out to have nothing below it lost its control, its alignment with the rows around it, and the keyboard focus.
- A long path was never shortened, and the footer could not wrap in a narrow window.
- The page indicator is announced when it changes, and the control that opens a row says which row it opens.

### Dependencies

- The release archive is uploaded with the gh CLI; softprops/action-gh-release is no longer used.

### Added

- One table in the dashboard listing everything in the libraries, from a whole series down to a single episode, with 38 columns across General, Video, Audio, Subtitles and Playback.
- Folder rows total what is below them: size, runtime and item count add up, an attribute the children disagree on reads as Mixed, and playback folds from the episodes or tracks underneath.
- A column selection per level and how far a tab opens, both remembered across restarts.
- Search across every level of a tab, sorting on any column, and paging.
- Export of the current view as CSV or ODS, in the language of the interface.
- English, German, Spanish, French and Italian.
